steps.prompt: You know $6 + 6 = 12$. How could that help you work out $6 + 7$?

cards.title: One more than a double
cards.body: When two numbers are next to each other, like $6$ and $7$, double the smaller one and add $1$: $6 + 7 = 12 + 1 = 13$. These are called near doubles.

steps.text: $8$ and $9$ are next to each other. Double the smaller one.

cards.title: Or one less
cards.body: You can also double the bigger number and take $1$ away: $8 + 9 = 18 - 1 = 17$. For numbers two apart, like $6 + 8$, double the middle number: double $7$ is $14$.

prompts: Do you prefer "double the smaller and add one" or "double the bigger and take one away"? Why?
